panels.title: Promedio, mínimo y máximo del periodo
panels.description: Cambia con el rango de tiempo de arriba.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.nombre AS "Dispositivo", l.variable AS "Variable", round(avg(l.valor)::numeric, 2) AS "Promedio", round(min(l.valor)::numeric, 2) AS "Mínimo", round(max(l.valor)::numeric, 2) AS "Máximo", count(*) AS "Lecturas" FROM lecturas l JOIN dispositivos d ON d.id = l.dispositivo WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT inicio AS "Inicio", fin AS "Fin", dispositivo AS "Dispositivo", nivel AS "Nivel", mensaje AS "Mensaje", round(valor_extremo::numeric, 2) AS "Valor extremo" FROM alertas WHERE $__timeFilter(inicio) ORDER BY inicio DESC

SELECT nombre AS "Dispositivo", categoria AS "Tipo", protocolo AS "Protocolo", CASE WHEN en_linea THEN 'En línea' ELSE 'Desconectado' END AS "Estado", ultimo_contacto AS "Último dato" FROM dispositivos ORDER BY categoria, nombre

SELECT ts AS "Hora", dispositivo AS "Dispositivo", accion AS "Acción", parametros AS "Parámetros", origen AS "Origen", estado AS "Estado", respuesta AS "Respuesta" FROM comandos WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC
